name: Offer Collect Applicant List in the popup beside Collect Every Applicant
request: Offer Collect Applicant List in the popup beside Collect Every Applicant
checks: npm run check passed (typecheck, build, 427 tests, validate)
result: Requested: add Collect Applicant List to the popup. It matters more there than on the Applicants page - the popup is what the recruiter has open while they are ON the hiring tab, which is the one place a list pass is started from. Rather than a second copy of the close discipline, collectEveryApplicant and collectApplicantList now share runApplicantJob(options, startedMessage): the popup still closes ONLY on the worker's own { ok: true, started: true }, which is its proof that it resolved the hiring tab, revealed it, got a matching-build PV_APPLICANT_PING, armed the auto-run and dispatched EXTRACT_ALL - anything less keeps the window open and shows the error, because a window that vanishes on failure is a button that silently did nothing. Still deliberately not runImport, which is shared with Start Collecting and Collect This Applicant and must never take the window away. The existing popup-close test now exercises the shared handler and additionally asserts that both commands route through it, so the two can no longer drift apart.
